question: Which Yoga pose teaches us to stand tall and balance on one leg just like a plant in the forest? 🌳
explanation: Awesome! In the Tree Pose, we balance on one leg and stretch our arms up like the branches of a strong tree! 🌳
hint: It has green leaves and strong roots.

question: Which seated yoga pose is named after a beautiful pink flower that grows in water? 🪷
explanation: Great job! Padmasana is called the Lotus Pose. We sit cross-legged with a straight back like a beautiful lotus! 🪷
hint: It is a beautiful pink water flower.

question: What is the best time of the day to practice our daily yoga? 🌅
explanation: Super! Early morning is the best time for yoga because the air is fresh and our minds are calm! 🌅
hint: When the sun is just waking up.

question: What should we place on the floor before we start doing our yoga poses? 🧘
explanation: Brilliant! A soft yoga mat keeps us safe, clean, and comfortable while we practice our poses! 🧘
hint: It is soft and unrolls on the floor.

question: Which fun yoga pose makes us flap our bent legs up and down like colorful wings? 🦋
explanation: Awesome! In Titli Asana (Butterfly Pose), we join our feet and flap our knees just like butterfly wings! 🦋
hint: It is a beautiful flying insect.

question: How should our back be when we sit down to do deep breathing? 📏
explanation: Great job! Keeping our back straight helps the fresh air reach our lungs easily when we breathe! 📏

question: What kind of clothes are best to wear while doing yoga? 👕
explanation: Super! Loose and comfortable clothes help our body bend, stretch, and move very easily! 👕
hint: Soft and easy to move in.

question: Which pose makes us lie down perfectly still like we are fast asleep? 😴
explanation: Awesome! Shavasana (Corpse Pose) gives our body deep rest after doing all the fun yoga exercises! 🛌
hint: You lie flat on your back.

question: What do we call the special deep breathing exercises in Yoga? 🌬️
explanation: Brilliant! Pranayama is the art of deep, slow breathing that makes our lungs very strong! 🌬️

question: What do we do with our shoes before stepping onto the yoga mat? 👟
explanation: Great job! We always do yoga barefoot so we can balance perfectly and keep our mat clean! 🦶

question: Which yoga pose is named after a tall, strong, and unmoving part of nature? ⛰️
explanation: Super! Tadasana is the Mountain Pose. It teaches us to stand tall, strong, and very steady! ⛰️
hint: It is very high and made of rock.

question: Which animal pose involves stretching our chest up from the floor like a hissing reptile? 🐍
explanation: Awesome! Bhujangasana is the Cobra Pose. We lift our chest up just like a snake lifting its head! 🐍

question: What happens to our body when we practice yoga every single day? 💪
explanation: Brilliant! Daily yoga makes our muscles strong, our body flexible, and our mind super sharp! 💪
hint: We get more power and energy.

question: Which fun pose makes us stick our tongue out and roar loudly? 🦁
explanation: Great job! Simhasana (Lion Pose) is super fun! We open our mouth wide and roar like the king of the jungle! 🦁

question: Before starting big yoga poses, what light activity should we do to prepare our body? 🤸
explanation: Super! Gentle warm-up exercises wake up our sleepy muscles so they are ready for yoga stretches! 🤸

question: How should we breathe while doing our peaceful yoga poses? 😌
explanation: Awesome! Slow and deep breathing brings lots of fresh oxygen to our brain and makes us calm! 😌

question: What is the very healthy series of poses we do to say 'Good Morning' to the sun? ☀️
explanation: Brilliant! Surya Namaskar (Sun Salutation) is a set of beautiful poses that gives us energy for the whole day! ☀️

question: Which pose requires us to sit on our knees and heels and is very good for our tummy? 💎
explanation: Great job! Vajrasana (Diamond Pose) is a sitting pose that helps our tummy digest food really fast! 💎

question: In the Cat Pose, what part of our body do we curve and stretch up towards the ceiling? 🐈
explanation: Super! In Marjaryasana (Cat Pose), we arch our back super high just like a stretching cat! 🐈
hint: The part of the body behind your tummy.

question: What magical thing does yoga do to our busy minds? 🧘‍♂️
explanation: Awesome! Yoga acts like magic! It sweeps away our worries and fills our mind with peace and calm. 🧘‍♂️
hint: It makes us feel happy and peaceful.

question: Which body part fills up like a big balloon when we take a deep breath in? 🎈
explanation: Brilliant! Our lungs are like balloons inside our chest that fill up with fresh, clean air when we breathe! 🫁

question: What does the word 'Asana' mean in our yoga class? 🧘‍♀️
explanation: Great job! 'Asana' is a special word that means the physical poses or postures we practice in yoga! 🧘‍♀️
hint: It is the shape your body makes.

question: To practice yoga best, our stomach should ideally be... 🍽️
explanation: Super! Doing yoga on a light or empty stomach helps our body bend and twist without feeling sick! 🍽️
hint: Not right after eating a big meal.

question: Which of these is a great place to practice yoga? 🌳
explanation: Awesome! A quiet garden gives us fresh air, nature sounds, and plenty of space to stretch out safely! 🌳
hint: A place with trees and grass.

question: Which sweet pose makes us curl up small and rest like a little baby? 👶
explanation: Brilliant! Balasana is the Child's Pose. We fold our body down to the floor to rest very peacefully. 👶

question: What is the best way to close our class after doing all our yoga asanas? 🙏
explanation: Great job! We finish our yoga by sitting quietly, taking a deep breath, and saying a happy 'Namaste'! 🙏

question: Which downward animal pose makes our body look like a big triangle shape? 🐕
explanation: Super! In the Downward-Facing Dog pose, our hands and feet are on the floor, stretching our whole back! 🐕

question: What is the very first step in deep breathing (Pranayama)? 👃
explanation: Awesome! The first step is inhaling (breathing in) nice, fresh air slowly through our nose! 🌬️

question: What is the step called when we slowly let the air out of our lungs? 😮‍💨
explanation: Brilliant! Exhaling (breathing out) helps our body push out old air and relax our muscles completely! 😮‍💨

question: If we practice stretching in yoga, our body will become very... 🤸‍♀️
explanation: Great job! Stretching makes our muscles super flexible, so we can touch our toes without bending our knees! 🤸‍♀️

question: What should we do with our eyes to concentrate better during seated breathing? 😌
explanation: Super! Closing our eyes gently blocks out distractions and helps our brain focus on our quiet breath! 😌

question: What is the proper way to breathe during our yoga practice? 👃
explanation: Awesome! Breathing through our nose filters the air and warms it up before it goes to our happy lungs! 👃
hint: The part of your face you smell with.

question: What does balancing on one leg in the Tree Pose improve? ⚖️
explanation: Brilliant! Balancing exercises train our brain to pay close attention and improve our daily focus! 🎯

question: What is the secret rule about the speed of moving into a yoga pose? 🐢
explanation: Great job! Moving slowly keeps our muscles safe from injury and helps us feel the lovely stretch! 🐢

question: What should we do if a yoga stretch hurts our body too much? 🛑
explanation: Super! Yoga should never hurt. If it pinches, we must gently stop and relax our body right away! 🛑

question: What beautiful shape do our joined hands make during 'Namaste'? 🙏
explanation: Awesome! Joining our palms at our chest in a prayer shape is a lovely way to show respect in yoga! 🙏
hint: Hands pressed together at the chest.

question: Who helps us learn the correct way to do yoga poses? 👩‍🏫
explanation: Brilliant! Our yoga teacher watches our form and gently guides us to do all the asanas safely! 👩‍🏫

question: What do we bring to our yoga class to drink after we finish exercising? 💧
explanation: Great job! Drinking a nice glass of water after class helps wash out toxins and cools our body down! 💧

question: What helps us balance perfectly when standing on one leg? 👀
explanation: Super! Staring at one still spot on the wall or floor acts like magic to keep our body from wobbling! 👀
hint: Fixing your eyes on a single point.

question: Which pose is a great pair with the Cat Pose to stretch our whole spine? 🐄
explanation: Awesome! We gently drop our tummy and look up for the Cow Pose, which perfectly pairs with the Cat Pose! 🐄

question: How often should primary school students try to practice simple yoga? 📅
explanation: Brilliant! Practicing yoga for a few minutes every single day keeps us healthy, happy, and very energetic! 📅

question: In the Lotus Pose (Padmasana), where do we place our hands while resting? 🧘‍♀️
explanation: Great job! We gently rest our hands on our knees with our palms facing upwards to feel relaxed! 🧘‍♀️
hint: The middle joint of your legs.

question: What does the word 'Surya' in Surya Namaskar mean? ☀️
explanation: Super! 'Surya' is the Sun, and we do Surya Namaskar to thank the sun for giving us warm, bright light! ☀️
hint: The big yellow star in the day sky.

question: Yoga is a magical exercise for our physical body and our... 🧠
explanation: Awesome! Yoga works out our muscles, and deep breathing gives our mind a super peaceful rest! 🧠
hint: The part that thinks inside your head.

question: How does doing yoga in the morning make us feel all day long? 😄
explanation: Brilliant! Morning yoga wakes up our body and gives us lots of bright energy to play and study! 😄

question: If our mind is very worried, what simple yoga trick helps us feel better? 🌬️
explanation: Great job! Taking three slow, deep breaths works like magic to blow all our worries far away! 🌬️
hint: Taking slow air in and out.

question: What should we keep on our face while practicing fun yoga poses? 😊
explanation: Super! Yoga is a joyful game for our body. A lovely smile relaxes our face muscles perfectly! 😊

question: To perform stretching poses correctly, we need enough... 📏
explanation: Awesome! Having enough open space means we will not bump into anything when we stretch our arms! 📏
hint: Room to stretch your arms out wide.

question: In Tadasana (Mountain Pose), where do we stretch our joined hands? ⬆️
explanation: Brilliant! We stand on our tiptoes and reach our hands up high to make our body as tall as a mountain! ⬆️

question: Ultimately, practicing yoga every day makes our lives very... ✨
explanation: Great job! Yoga keeps our bodies fit, our minds calm, and our hearts completely full of joy! ✨
